crewNotes.text: General Japan traveller allowances; crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with Japan Customs. Compiled from the cited Japan Customs guide, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Adults may bring in 3 bottles of alcoholic beverages (about 760 ml each) duty-free.
Cash or payment instruments exceeding JPY 1,000,000 (or equivalent) must be declared to Customs.

declarationRequirements.text: Other goods with a total overseas market value up to JPY 200,000 are duty-free (items under JPY 10,000 each are excluded from the total); above that, goods must be declared.

rules.text: Adults may bring in 200 cigarettes, or 50 cigars, or 10 packages of heat-not-burn tobacco, or 250g of other tobacco (250g combined limit).

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
